corrections.observation: execute_update guest reached the original error-status jump-table read at app PC 0x2eaea04; the source RO page was absent from the initial bounded map.
corrections.resolution: Mapped the real file-backed source page containing the nine-byte table at 0x399f5ec and made it read-only. All nine intended cases then passed. No guessed RAM or missing snapshot pages were supplied.

corrections.observation: Two exploratory static reads of crypter global 0x412094 failed because it is BSS rather than file-backed data.
corrections.resolution: Retained View.read rejection. Recorded SHT_NOBITS and init-array pointers without claiming a runtime FILE_CHUNK argument or zero-filled WBI evidence.

corrections.observation: The first external-command listing attempt assumed a single .rodata section and stopped on a module with a different section layout.
corrections.resolution: The new phase's listing helper now identifies allocated read-only non-code sections explicitly. Rebuilt the unsealed static outputs; the original nine entry fragments still contain 93 annotated literals.

fixture_boundaries: Registration replies, file-preparation results, backup operations, process requests and follow-up actions in execute_update_guest are explicit host fixtures.
media_length_guest reads the official original file only. Its two threshold fixtures are sixteen-byte prefixes without payload or signatures; execution stops at the first payload-read request.
Selected ELF mappings use file bytes and declared synthetic RAM; no omitted WBI memory is filled or represented as recovered.
Kernel module analysis is static ET_REL only; no native kernel module, ioctl, USB or camera operation occurs.
A typed success result, small header/checksum pass or direct dlopen call is not a whole-container admission or flash receipt.
